# NPM Improved v1.8.0-beta.2

Prerelease update-delivery correction for the v1.8 beta.

## Fixed

- Added the required **ARM64** application and native instance-firewall images, alongside AMD64. A published beta is installable only when its release archive contains the host architecture and its matching firewall companion.
- Avoided synchronous self-reloads of an already-active root-owned updater service; fresh maintenance timers retry at five-minute intervals.
- Removed manual host-updater command prompts from the update page. Native updater maintenance remains part of the authenticated in-app release process.
- Preserved independent Stable, Beta, and Alpha/RC discovery and prevented selecting an unavailable architecture artifact.
- Retained existing in-place update health checks, verification, persistent volumes, and rollback.

## Scope

This is a beta release for validation, not a new stable release. The existing v1.8 instance-security beta functionality is unchanged; this update completes architecture availability and the update-delivery path.

## Published artifacts required

The release is complete **only** after both AMD64 and ARM64 verified application bundles are attached with their matching instance-firewall images, the native host-updater archive and SHA-256 checksums. Do not publish a partial single-architecture release.
